title: A delivery with a reused task id reopens a host-closed task and nothing closes it again
observation: appendEvent reopens a task whose closed_by is 'host' on any new observation (state -> open, finished_at -> null, closed_by cleared). The grounding text tells agents to 'Reuse the ID for follow-up work on the same task', so on the next prompt an agent that passes the previous prompt's task_id to hunch_context reopens that host-closed task. No Stop for that old prompt id follows (Stop closes the current prompt's id), so the old task stays open forever and taskRecordFromReports drops it from the episode record; the new observation is lost too. Reproduced 2026-09-16 with a scratch node:test: start A, delivery, finishReportTask(by:'host') -> completed; recordTaskDelivery(A) -> state open, closed_by undefined, finished_at null; taskRecordFromReports([A]) -> null. Same failure class as fnd_6ec3c15f15 (issue #263), different trigger; fix options: only reopen when the observation comes from the same prompt/turn, or host-close the previous session task on the next prompt's start.
evidence: scratch test output: 'after host close: completed' / 'after stale-id delivery: open closed_by= undefined finished_at= null' / 'record from open task: null'
src/core/taskReport.ts appendEvent: if (task.closed_by !== 'host') throw ...; else UPDATE report_tasks SET state open
CLAUDE.md grounding block: 'Reuse the ID for follow-up work on the same task; never borrow another task's ID.'
